# Pre-H24 reference fixture

Generated by the root module at commit
`68708eb852ee900d636edec0fe3e4d8d0fbe1f59` using `generate.go`, fixed event time
2026-10-19 10:00:00 UTC and an initially empty Brain. Do not regenerate against
the candidate code: it would erase the independent compatibility reference.

`commands.jsonl` contains schema 1 sequence learning, text and language
observations (including mixed case, context/data and inline learning), a
low-level fallback, cognitive fallback and written knowledge import.
`prefix-checkpoint.json` anchors the first command. `reference.json` records
the detached complete v7 state checksum, exact next cognitive-think output,
post-thought checksum and historical bootstrap Brain hash.

To reproduce, check out the documented parent in an independent working tree
and run its Go module with this generator's absolute path and an empty output
directory. The test copies journal bytes before opening a writer; these fixture
files are never mutated by validation.
